title: 对话 · 预约游泳课
intro: Sample recording, part one. You will hear a woman phoning a sports centre about swimming lessons. First, you have some time to look at questions one to five.

turns.speaker: MAN
turns.text: Good morning, Riverside Sports Centre. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: WOMAN
turns.text: Hello. I'm calling about the swimming lessons for adults. Are there any places left on the evening course?

turns.speaker: MAN
turns.text: Let me have a look. The Tuesday group is full, I'm afraid, but there are still three places on Thursday.

turns.speaker: WOMAN
turns.text: Thursday would be fine. What time does it start?

turns.speaker: MAN
turns.text: At a quarter past seven, and each lesson lasts forty-five minutes.

turns.speaker: WOMAN
turns.text: And how much does the whole course cost?

turns.speaker: MAN
turns.text: It's £62 for eight weeks, and that includes the use of the gym on the same evening.
turns.say: It's sixty-two pounds for eight weeks, and that includes the use of the gym on the same evening.

turns.speaker: WOMAN
turns.text: That sounds reasonable. Do I need to bring any equipment?

turns.speaker: MAN
turns.text: Just a towel and a swimming cap. We provide floats and goggles for beginners.

turns.speaker: WOMAN
turns.text: Great. Can I book a place now?

turns.speaker: MAN
turns.text: Of course. Could I have your surname, please?

turns.speaker: WOMAN
turns.say: It's Hartley. That's H, A, R, T, L, E, Y.

turns.speaker: MAN
turns.text: Thank you. And a contact number?

turns.speaker: WOMAN
turns.say: Yes, it's oh seven nine four six, three one eight, two oh five.

turns.speaker: MAN
turns.text: Lovely. The first lesson is on the twelfth of March, so please arrive about ten minutes early to fill in a short health questionnaire.
